definition_summary: Use of a zoning lot for one detached housing unit.
section: §911.02 (definition in Use Table); §926.01 cross-refers; standards §911.04.A.69 (H district only: buildable land <30% slope, soils report, clearing max 10% or 2,400 sf)

definition_summary: One dwelling unit attached to one or more dwelling units by a party wall or separate abutting wall, located on its own separate lot.
threshold: 1 unit per lot; in single-unit detached districts (R1D) by right if lot width <=35 ft, Special Exception if >35 ft (§911.04.A.69A); in H district SE with max 4 units per cluster (§911.04.A.69(c))

definition_summary: Use of a zoning lot for two dwelling units contained within a single building.
Use of a zoning lot for three dwelling units contained within a single building.
Use of a zoning lot for four or more dwelling units contained within a single building.
threshold: 4+ dwelling units in one building; district-specific standards in UI (units may be limited to upper floors), EMI (Ch. 916 compatibility), UC-E (100% affordable on site, or residential <50% of GFA)

definition_summary: A Housing for the Elderly use with fewer than 30 units. No separate definition of the parent term 'Housing for the Elderly' was found in §911.02 or §926.01.
threshold: <30 units. Standards (§911.04.A.35(a)): common dining and social rooms required; >=40% of required lot in ground-level usable open space (min 8 ft wide); reasonable transit access; flat terrain and nearby services 'should'; extra parking may be required. In residential districts and RIV-RM (A.35(b)): residential character; Approving Body may allow density up to 1 unit per 450 sf. UI: Site Plan Review. Lighter standards in RIV-MU/NS/IMU, UC-E, UC-MU, R-MU (A.35(d)).

definition_summary: A Housing for the Elderly use with 30 or more units.

A facility for the accommodation of convalescents or chronically ill persons, in which nursing care and medical services are prescribed or performed under the direction of persons licensed under Commonwealth law.
threshold: Classes by patient beds (A <9, B 9-17, C 18+)

definition_summary: Assisted Living use with fewer than 9 patient beds.
threshold: <9 patient beds. Lot area 5,000 sf + 500 sf per sleeping room over 3 (every 2 beds = 1 sleeping room; Board may reduce for pre-5/10/1958 buildings); max 1 per building, not in a building with any other residential use; SPACING: no closer than 800 ft (radius from building center) to any other authorized Assisted Living, group residence or group care facility; 24-hour non-client adult supervision; no basement sleeping rooms; 10 ft min interior side yard in residential districts; parking 1 per 2 FT staff + 1 per 3 driving residents. Site Plan Review in NDO/LNC/NDI.

definition_summary: Assisted Living use with 9 to 17 patient beds.
threshold: 9-17 patient beds. Lot area 5,000 sf + 300 sf per sleeping room over 3; same 800 ft spacing, one-per-building, supervision, basement, side-yard and parking rules as Class A; Approving Body detriment finding.

definition_summary: Assisted Living use with 18 or more patient beds.
threshold: 18+ patient beds. Lot area 5,000 sf + 300 sf per sleeping room over 3; same 800 ft spacing and other Class A/B rules. In RM and Grandview Public Realm: must look residential, parking screened, lot area computed as dwelling units at 2 beds per unit.

definition_summary: A personal care residence of 3 to 10 persons including clients, the operator and the operator's family; clients max 8. Operator may be the householder.
threshold: 3-10 total persons; <=8 clients. Lot area 5,000 sf + 300 sf per sleeping room over 3; SPACING: no closer than 800 ft to any other authorized Personal Care Residence or health-care-related facility; 24-hour supervision; no basement sleeping rooms; 10 ft interior side yard in residential districts; parking 1 per 2 FT staff + 1 per 3 driving non-staff; 80% of clients must be 62+ or disabled (FHA 1988). Extra standards in RM/Grandview and NDO/LNC/NDI/UNC.

definition_summary: A personal care residence of no more than 19 persons including clients, the operator and the operator's family; clients max 17.
threshold: <=19 total persons; <=17 clients. Lot area 5,000 sf + 300 sf per sleeping room over 3; 800 ft spacing from other Personal Care Residences or health-care facilities; 24-hour supervision; no basement sleeping rooms; 10 ft interior side yard in residential districts; parking as Small; Approving Body detriment finding; 80% of clients 62+ or disabled.

definition_summary: A group of MORE than eight unrelated disabled persons (FHA 1988 'handicapped') living as a single housekeeping unit with shared common facilities; staff may reside. Not Multi-Suite or Assisted Living; excludes Custodial Care Facilities; includes halfway houses after hospitalization/treatment, but not halfway houses for people leaving a correctional facility.
threshold: >8 unrelated disabled persons (8 or fewer = a 'Family' under §926.01, i.e. an ordinary dwelling). Standards: one primary entrance, single mailbox and utility connections, common kitchen; no exterior alteration beyond what single-family dwellings may do; average max 1 disabled resident per bedroom; no substantial interior alteration to add bedrooms; parking 1 per 3 persons on duty; office for on-site program use only; Approving Body must find no saturation of Community Homes or social-service institutions (no fixed distance).

definition_summary: (a) persons related by blood, marriage or adoption; (b) up to 3 unrelated persons as a single housekeeping unit; or (c) up to 8 unrelated disabled persons as a single housekeeping unit, plus 1 resident staff not counted. A Family may not be a Multi-Suite Residential or Assisted Living facility.
threshold: <=3 unrelated persons; <=8 unrelated disabled persons (+1 staff)

definition_summary: A Multi-Suite Residential use with fewer than 8 sleeping rooms. No separate definition of the parent term was found in §911.02 or §926.01 ('Suite' = one or a group of connected living or sleeping rooms, §926.01).
threshold: <8 sleeping rooms (every 2 beds in a room counts as 1 sleeping room, §926.01 'Sleeping Room'). In RM and Grandview: residential character, parking min 1 space per 2 sleeping rooms, detriment finding. In LNC: Site Plan Review, parking 1 per 2 sleeping rooms. EMI and other districts: further standards (incl. Project Development Plan in some).

definition_summary: A Multi-Suite Residential use with 8 or more sleeping rooms.
threshold: 8+ sleeping rooms. In LNC: character, parking min 1 per 2 sleeping rooms, detriment finding; further UI and other district standards.

definition_summary: Facilities in one or more structures providing housing for people who are homeless or facing homelessness, with shelter and support to transition to permanent housing; excludes Custodial Care Facility and Personal Care Residence.
threshold: No resident/unit threshold. Standards: Development Activities Meeting if §178E.08 criteria met; application must describe site layout/access, living arrangements, bathroom and dining, storage, wrap-around services; Approving Body must find operator capable; Approving Body MAY WAIVE underlying zoning standards if §911.04.A.101 is met. No spacing rule.

definition_summary: A dwelling unit smaller than 800 sf, accessory to a structure with a legally established single dwelling unit; may be internal, detached, or within an existing accessory structure. Allowed only inside a mapped ADU Overlay District.
threshold: <800 sf; max 1 per zoning lot; owner must live on site; min 30-day leases; max 2 stories / 30 ft; exempt from minimum lot size (per unit) and on-site parking; deed restriction before CO; only accessory to structures with no more than 1 legal dwelling unit. Interim overlay = 24 months from effective date.
